original_description: Create typography previews or place selected PNG, JPEG and WebP artwork, including images generated in ChatGPT, on a black shirt. A clickable result card opens editable layers in the completely free ShirtLab studio. Move and resize artwork, export an editable .shirtlab project, or download the current print area as a transparent PNG. Export downloads happen in the studio. The MCP imports existing files; native ChatGPT image generation and file availability depend on the host and may require a separate message. No ShirtLab account or AI credits are needed. Image snapshots are accessible to anyone holding their link and expire after 24 hours. Buying a physical printed shirt is optional through website checkout.
summary_ja: 画像や文字を黒いシャツに配置し、編集可能なデザインや印刷用PNGを作る。
limitations: 画像スナップショットはリンクを知る人が閲覧でき24時間で期限切れとの説明。画像生成はホスト側の機能に依存し、出力はShirtLab studioで行う。実動作・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
